description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mallawapitiya, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420201 and Others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including details of ownership, property boundaries, encumbrances, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on property registration and land settlement matters, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
